description: Land Acquisition - Greater Colombo Flood Control and Environment Improvement Project, Kotikawatta D/S Division, Colombo District, Angoda, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels in Kotikawaththa area for flood control and townscape development. It contains detailed descriptions of 40 land lots with their boundaries, extents, claimants, and present land uses. The content primarily deals with land acquisition matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters including land acquisitions, transfers, and property descriptions.
